full_description: In the KitchenS scene, a pan of meatballs sits on a lit burner at the right-top of the counter, with a plate toward the center-left and a salad bowl, drink bottle, and cup on the left. Turn the stove off, pick up the pan, and tip it carefully so the meatballs fall onto the plate. Success requires every meatball on the plate; any ball that falls off the plate is a failure.
